Core Sequencing: when rules trigger at the same time during the battle, the player whose turn it is picks the order. Active-first is one order that player could choose. Each Ka'tah stance only changes its own side's melee attacks, and the best stance depends on the enemy's Toughness, not the enemy's stance. So whoever picks second gains nothing, and the fixed order plays the same as a chosen one.
